text:
maya: quick heads-up — pushing an impromptu triage + RFC sync. Seen a spike in kv-cache fallback errors in eu-prod since the 03:00 deploy. Can we grab 20m to sync and decide rollback vs patch? bridge: https://meet.redwood.ai/bridge/abc123

dan: on it, joining in ~1m. grabbing logs and the deploy diff.

alex: joining now. which routes are most impacted?

maya: /v1/generate and /v1/chat primarily. p95 latency + 504s on a small % of requests.

priya: I can repro locally with a short sequence (seq_len ~512). stack looks like a KV eviction race — sending stack snippet.

priya: ```
2023-11-02T03:12:07Z error runtime kvcache: eviction failed: index out of range
goroutine 234 [running]:
...
```

dan: that matches the SRE alarms I pulled. can someone check if the autoscaler recently changed batch_size or prefetch?

maya: autoscaler policy was untouched, but we flipped a quantization flag in the model build yesterday. not sure if related.

sre-bot: incident INC-2345 created (priority: P2) — linked to alerts.kv-cache.europe.

alex: if it's an eviction race, short-term plan: 1) pin node pool to older runtime, 2) disable prefix caching for heavy routes, 3) patch eviction bounds. which one can we do fastest?

maya: option 1 (pin node pool) is fastest. dan can roll a pinned pool and route ~10% traffic as canary.

dan: can do. I'll open a rollback/rollout PR and post link in the bridge.

priya: I'll prepare a minimal repro and a unit test for the eviction window. should have that in ~30m.

alex: I'll watch the canary and metrics dashboard. ping me if p95 drops < previous baseline.

maya: agenda for the 20m: 1) current state + logs (dan/priya) 2) choose immediate mitigation (pin/disable caching) 3) assign leads for patch + tests 4) rollout plan and communication.

dan: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/+/1234 — rolling canary now.

priya: joining the bridge. starting repro run.

alex: +1. leave a short note in #incidents once we have canary metrics. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks team — if you're on-call and can't make the bridge, drop status here. otherwise see you in the bridge.
